stats.notes: Baseline: no Common Data Set found on lasalle.edu (2 searches, no CDS page). Exact counts are IPEDS ADM2024 (fall 2024 first-time degree-seeking: 4,782 applied, 4,619 admitted = 97%, 437 enrolled), matching College Navigator's 4,782 applicants and 97% admitted. IPEDS does not split international applicants, so intl_applicants/intl_admits are not available. SAT/ACT scores are not reported to IPEDS, so no percentiles.
